summary: Alterity Therapeutics filed a Form 6-K with an attached cleansing notice under Australian Corporations Act Section 708A, reporting the completion of an issue of 8,400,000 ordinary shares to MST Financial Services and sub-underwriters pursuant to an underwriting agreement announced August 31, 2026, related to the company's ATHO options exercisable at A$0.50 that expired August 31, 2026. This routine share issuance notice, equivalent to a Regulation S-K item 3.02 disclosure, involves no premium, deal terms, or special-situation event. It is a standard equity financing disclosure.
